precepts.text: Your God will come with vengeance; he will come and save you.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
Paul thanks God “because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth.” That is what the body needs: brothers and sisters charitable toward each other, with that charity abounding, “in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure.” We will suffer for the kingdom of God, and in the suffering we still have to maintain love for our neighbor. It is not about one man; it is about the body of Christ.

Then: “Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you.” The ones troubling the apostles in Thessalonica were Rome. And the Lord Jesus shall be revealed “in flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.” Christ is coming back for vengeance. That was never taught in church, but it has been in the Bible all along.

Isaiah says the same thing in the Old: “Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.” Be strong and do not fear; your God is coming back with vengeance and with the recompense we just read in Thessalonians.

“He will come and save you”: not all people. He is coming to save the Israelites. He is not coming for Christians, not for the Baptists, not for any denomination. And the vengeance falls on those who obey not the gospel, like our people who keep repeating the same evil every year, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s, knowing these things are not of God.

Oh, you thought this wasn't in the New Testament. Oh yes it is. “Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;” Never heard a church read that, and my mom used to drag us from church to church. So it's a righteous thing with God to do what? To recompense, pay back, tribulation to them that trouble you. Now you got to ask yourself, who's troubling us? Some of you are going to point to Pooky and Ray Ray. Well, Pooky and Ray Ray got that insane mentality they got because of this system. This system has warped and perverted Pooky and Ray Ray. You are a product of your environment. There was a movie on Netflix, They Cloned Tyrone: you had Tyrone, you had the hoe, and they each played a part, and that's how our people are as a whole. And also remember, Esau did very in-depth studies on our people before putting us in the ghettos and redlining and things of that nature. It's called the behavioral sink; look that up, where they did that same ghetto setup with mice. The mice began to create gangs. They began to kill one another. The male mice became effeminate, only focusing on themselves. It was everything you see in our communities. They actually did studies before setting it into place, so they already knew what was going to happen. They are the damn devil the Bible speaks of.

“And to you who are troubled rest with us,” That's the good news, and this is our message to our brothers and sisters. But they got to acknowledge and understand that they are a troubled people, a troubled race. Rest with us in these scriptures; come be comforted in these scriptures. “when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, In flaming fire taking vengeance” Taking what? Vengeance. Remember it says this is the day of vengeance, the year of vengeance: we just read that in Isaiah 61 and in Isaiah 34:8 as well. “on them that know not God,” Edom, and all who follow him too. “and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:” That obey not the good news of our Lord Jesus Christ.

“Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power; When he shall come to be glorified in his saints,” We're the saints. “and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.”

points: We glory in you for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure. You keep reading about the persecutions our forefathers and the believers in Christ went through; the same thing is going to happen again. We must endure; we cannot give up when things get bad.

Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer. When you go through affliction and endure it, that is how the Lord counts who is worthy.

Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you. The people that bring affliction on us and trouble us, God says he is going to pay them back. So do not worry.
We glory in you for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure. Like Christ said in Matthew 24: endure unto the end.

Out in Kenya they stoned us, and Israelites laughed: you had to teach in Hamite lands. The disciples got stoned; Paul got stoned. And right here in Babylon they tried to do a drive-by on us, and a woman tried to run us over. A lot of Israelites do not want that. They will teach where it is safe: go downtown to a safe area and talk tough all day, but never go to the hard neighborhoods, never leave the country to find their people. Israel is scattered abroad, but they say, stay in America. That is fear. You can afford multiple women but cannot afford one passport; a passport costs about a hundred dollars. My kids have passports.
